content:
If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is 0.00–0.33 and forecast is above true value, subtract 1–2% from forecast for late horizon (16–30 days).

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is below true value, add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for early horizon.

If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is rising, cap increase at 1.0% for mid horizon.

If sentiment is 0.67–1.00 and forecast is falling, reduce by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon.
